title: Casper and the Portrait
author: Wren Lockridge
blurb: Odile Delacroix, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
